name: Sakaki
source:
[i]"...Perhaps you have heard the rumors? These incidents that have been occurring in Itehari are unprecedented."[/i]

The prime minister of the Ryuei, the legislative body of Itehari. As the most powerful person after the Taiju, he is in charge of most governmental affairs, essentially making him Itehari's ruler.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/itehari/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
